prompt: `item_make` should copy at most 15 characters into a 16-byte `name`. Long names corrupt memory. Tap the faulty line.
explain: `name` has 16 bytes, indexes 0 to 15, and one must stay free for the terminator. With `i < 16` the loop can reach `i == 16` and then write the terminator at `name[16]`, one byte past the array. The limit must be `i < 15`.
